title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: When Deposits Post and Which Are Accepted
content:
Credits to a Savings & Money Market Accounts product post only when the funds are available, so the balance shown is always money the owner can use. This page sets out the posting day for each kind of credit, the checks on mobile deposits, and the account states in which deposits are taken.

## Rule

**Posting equals availability.** Credits reach the ledger only on the business day their funds are available for use; the current balance and the available balance are therefore the same figure.

**Posting day by kind of credit.**

| Credit | Posts on |
|---|---|
| Cash | the business day it is received |
| ACH credit | the business day it is received |
| Incoming wire | the business day it is received |
| Internal transfer or automatic transfer | the business day it is received |
| Deposited check, account open for at least the tier's new-account period | the next business day |
| Deposited check, account open for fewer calendar days than the tier's new-account period | the business day after deposit given by the tier's new-account hold figure |

**Mobile deposit limits.** A mobile deposit is taken only if, with it included, the day's mobile deposits stay within the tier's daily mobile figure and the mobile deposits of the 30 calendar days ending on the deposit date, that date included, stay within the tier's 30-day mobile figure. A mobile deposit that would break either figure is turned away and never posts.

**Which accounts take deposits.** Active and dormant accounts accept deposits. An account in applied status accepts one only as its opening deposit. A closed account accepts none.

**Deposits and dormancy.** An ACH credit, an incoming wire or an automatic transfer never counts as activity initiated by the customer for dormancy purposes.

## Hypothetical cases

- A check is deposited on a Tuesday to an account opened ten days earlier, on a tier whose new-account period is longer than ten days and whose hold figure is the fifth business day. With no holidays that week or the next, the check posts on the following Tuesday.
- The same check deposited to an account opened long ago posts on Wednesday, the next business day.
- A mobile deposit of 600.00 arrives on a day when 500.00 has already come in by mobile deposit, on a tier whose daily mobile figure is assumed to be 1000.00. The day's total would reach 1100.00, so the deposit is refused.

## Points of judgement

**Can an ACH payroll credit bring a dormant account back to life?** It posts to the dormant account, but it is not customer-initiated activity.
